About this Event

🎬✨ TAMASHA BHOOTS: A Desi Costume Party Like No Other ✨🎬
Hosted by: TAMASHA NIGHTS
🗓️ One unforgettable night. One epic Bollywood Halloween bash.

👻 HALLOWEEN GOES FULL DESI!Forget basic costumes. TAMASHA BHOOTS is where Bollywood meets Bhoot — and the more dramatic, filmy, spooky, or ridiculous you get, the better. 👻🔥
Come dressed as your favorite Bollywood character, a classic bhoot, or a Bollywood Bhoot of your own creation. Think SRK, Madhuri, Ranveer, Deepika, Kareena… or turn your favorite Bollywood icon into their supernatural alter ego. 🧛🏽‍♀️🎬
Whether you’re serving Bollywood superstar, filmi villain, desi ghost, haunted heroine, spooky hero, or full-on Bollywood Bhoot- this is your night to bring the character to life.
Because at TAMASHA, we don’t just party… we make a scene. 🎭👻
💥 Bollywood music all night long- from iconic classics and party anthems to today’s biggest Desi hits.
🔥 Nonstop Bollywood beats, high-energy vibes, and throwbacks to keep the dance floor going all night.

👻 THE TAMASHA BHOOTS DRESS CODEThere is NO MANDATORY DRESS CODE- but we HIGHLY encourage you to dress up!
🎬 Bollywood Character
👻 Bhoot
🔥 Bollywood Bhoot
😈 Filmi Villain
💃 Spooky Bollywood Diva
🧛🏽 Whatever your imagination comes up with
This is your excuse to go all out.
Come recognizable. Come unrecognizable. Just COME IN CHARACTER. 👻🎬

🥂 VIP VIBES? WE GOT YOU.
Wanna party like a celeb?
Book a VIP experience and enjoy:
✔️ Front-of-the-line access
✔️ Reserved table all night
✔️ Personal bartender + bottle service
📲 Text/Call/WhatsApp: to book VIP or ask questions

🎟 TICKET INFO
🎫 Early Bird starts at just $25
💥 General Admission, Group Discounts, and VIP Packages available
🚫 Ticket is for entry only — food & drinks sold separately
⚠️ Prices go up as we get closer – don’t wait!

21+ only. VALID PHYSICAL ID REQUI
